notes.title: MM Update
notes.notes:
I have changed a lot in the game to make the experience better and more terrifying.

I fixed the player getting stuck on trees and mannequins pushing the player out of the building.

I added a Map in game so players know the layout better.

Added more jump scares.

I changed the objectives in game as well to clarify what to do next as well as making the objectives easier.

I added Health in game. Red Cross pickups will give you full health, which you'll find in between Cabin Rooms and in the House.

I changed the lighting and graphics a little for appeal. Also added green fog around the graveyard for  letting the player know from a distance where you're at in game.

I changed the setting where if you die in game, it automatically restart the current level, instead of choosing to retry or quit which has let players loose the option if you clicked on screen away from the buttons.

I added 2 different endings. The default ending will be the bad ending where you don't save your Sister. However, if you find the secret where you choose differently in game, you will get the true ending and save your Sister. Can you save your Sister?

Thank you for playing. Hope you enjoy and welcome to Motel Murder.

NG Smith
